description: Phase 5.2 WhatsApp Delivery Scheduler - scheduled daily/weekly summary delivery with idempotency, skip rules, and delivery logging.

userStories.title: Daily scheduler for PREMIUM users
userStories.description: As a PREMIUM user, I should receive daily summary messages when eligible.
acceptanceCriteria: Daily scheduler runs and processes PREMIUM users only
FREE users are not sent via daily scheduler

userStories.title: Weekly scheduler for FREE users
userStories.description: As a FREE user, I should receive weekly summary messages when eligible.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly scheduler runs and processes FREE users only
PREMIUM users are not sent via weekly scheduler

userStories.title: Skip inactive/ineligible users safely
userStories.description: As system ops, scheduler should avoid unnecessary sends while continuing healthy processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Inactive or non-deliverable users are skipped
Pipeline continues for other users when one user is skipped/failed

userStories.title: Idempotent delivery behavior
userStories.description: As users, we should not receive duplicate messages for the same cadence window.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running the same cadence window does not duplicate WhatsApp messages
Idempotency keying (user + cadence + window) is implemented and tested

userStories.title: Test matrix and CI evidence
userStories.description: As engineering, we need confidence and traceability for scheduler and delivery behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover skip behavior and idempotency
CI evidence is documented in task docs
